question: Does three-third token position add transferable value to direct threat_rank regression beyond a matched unigram bag and shuffled-position control?
selection_disclosure: Adaptive development pilot. E67 and E75 query views overlap and are not untouched validation.
target: Official threat_rank in [0,100]; direct fit on every same-prefix row, including missing-text rows. Query labels are excluded from each origin's fit.

features.structured: Original RegressionTextModel._structured_fit semantics on HYBRID_FEATURES structured columns, including cycle_code; processor, StandardScaler and OneHotEncoder each fit once per origin and are shared across all three arms.
features.bag: Transform-only unigram columns from the standalone target-free E67/E75 word TF-IDF vectorizers, normalized with sklearn L2; no vocabulary or IDF fit.
features.real: [structured, unigram bag, existing original three-third REAL suffix, missing_text_indicator].
features.shuffled: [structured, unigram bag, existing original deterministic seed42 shuffled-position suffix, missing_text_indicator].
features.position_source: POSITIONAL_TEXT_PILOT_V1 fit_position/score_position and fit_shuffled_position/score_shuffled_position, sliced after the exact corresponding base width. Require numeric vectorizer state, vocabulary, parameters, rows, IDs, cycles, missing mask, physical/logical matrix hashes, and sampled REAL/SHUFFLED reconstruction to pass before freeze.

estimator.resolved_parameters: Captured completely in the immutable FREEZE.json before production fit.
estimator.fit_policy: No validation set, evaluation set, early stopping, weights, recency adjustment, grid search, retry, or extra fit.

fixed_competition_policy.baseline: Final mapped current R06 OOF prediction loaded from the E67/E75 R06 fit caches and identity-checked against Regression Train.
fixed_competition_policy.rank_mapping: For each complete origin query cycle, rank raw auxiliary scores with average ties; percentile=100*rank/n; mapped=0.5*raw+0.5*percentile.
fixed_competition_policy.missing_text: Calculate full-cycle rank mapping and blend before the missing mask; then replace missing-text candidate scores with the exact cached_current_R06 values. Do not re-rank after blending.

accounting.learned_units: Per origin: one structured processor, one numeric scaler, one categorical OHE, and three direct LGBM estimators.
accounting.resume: A durable, hash-verified unit is loaded without refit. A consumed but non-durable start cannot be retried.

protected_groups.quartiles: Fit-prefix 0.25/0.5/0.75 linear quantiles; duplicate edges collapsed; query bins use np.digitize(..., right=False).

gates.missing_route: Bit-exact R06 fallback for every missing-text query row.
gates.eligibility: No automatic promotion or submission. Preserve failures and UNKNOWN groups for a separate Sol decision.

late_view_definition: Use E67 predictions only on cycles 68-71 (W4), and E75 predictions on cycles 76-79 (W6). This union has each record once; E75_W6 rows overlap E67_W6 fully, so do not add the E67_W6 copy.
